text:
Eileen (SE): kicking off thread for HarborBank pilot. They need streaming chat + server-side tool calls that fire to internal order-service + strict JSON schema for downstream ingestion. Main asks: Go/Rust SDK snippets for streaming + tool callbacks, ephemeral creds pattern, hosted vs reserved pricing, and SOC2/KMS language for contract.
Jordan (AE): client expects ~200 rps peak, mostly business hours (9h/day). Theyre leaning reserved if latency is guaranteed.
Linh (Eng): recommendation: reserved Dedicated pool for predictable p95 <250ms at that QPS. Hosted could work for pilot but expect occasional tail spikes. Need exact SLA target to finalize.
Eileen (SE): SLA target is p95 <250ms. Also they require webhook calls to internal endpoints with mTLS and IP allowlist.
Omar (Security): checklist: require mutual TLS for webhooks, IP allowlist, short-lived webhook tokens (rotated), and option to route callbacks via a customer-owned queue. For KMS: Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Dedicated can negotiate EKM.
Linh (Eng): runbook (high level):
1) Stand up 1-node Dedicated pool 
2) Configure model variant + enable structured_output_mode with strict_schema=true
3) Configure KV prefix caching for repeated prompts
4) Deploy credential-broker (STS) for ephemeral tokens
5) Provision webhook endpoint with mTLS and allowlist
6) Enable schema_violation webhook to send events to their telemetry

Linh (Eng): Rust SDK streaming + tool-call example:
```rust
let client = redwood::Client::with_token_provider(MyTokenProvider::new());
let mut stream = client.chat_stream("retail-redwood-1", messages).await?;
while let Some(evt) = stream.next().await {
    match evt {
        Event::Delta(d) => print("{}", d.text),
        Event::ToolCall(req) => handle_tool_call(req).await?,
        Event::Done => break,
    }
}
```
Eileen (SE): good. How does the ephemeral STS flow look? They dont want long-lived creds on their order service.
Linh (Eng): recommended pattern: Redwood STS endpoint issues short-lived API tokens (TTL 15m). Customer runs a tiny credential-broker (lambda/container) which exchanges a long-lived service credential for STS token and returns to the service. SDK TokenProvider refreshes when TTL <60s. We can provide sample lambda.
SDKBot: demo artifacts: https://internal.redwood/poctemplates/harborbank (terraform, sample broker, demo app).
Jordan (AE): pricing ask: please give two scenarios: hosted per-token estimate for pilot hours (9h/day) and reserved 1-node monthly commit. Need ballpark numbers for EOD.
Linh (Eng): rough calc outline: tokens = rps * avg_tokens * seconds_per_day * days. For 200 rps, 150 tokens, 9h/day -> ~77.76M tokens/day -> ~2.3B tokens/month (30d). Hosted = $X per 1M tokens. Reserved = flat monthly + lower unit. Ill run two scenarios: 9h/day pilot and 24/7 pilot and post numbers.
Omar (Security): SOC2 response: we are SOC2 Type II audited (standard boilerplate). KMS: Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Dedicated can include EKM addendum. For webhooks: require mTLS, IP allowlist, and minimum TLS1.2+ cipher suites. I'll draft wording for the questionnaire.
Eileen (SE): schema validation: can Redwood reject invalid JSON and surface an error to caller? Client prefers fail-fast rather than post-hoc correction.
Linh (Eng): yes: enable strict_schema=true and policy action=reject. The service will return a 422 with validation errors, emit a schema_violation event, and optionally route the raw output to a review queue. Also we can auto-fallback to a safer model variant on repeated violations.
Jordan (AE): blockers before the kickoff: 1) legal: EKM wording in contract, 2) need sample credential-broker and terraform template, 3) pricing by EOD.
Linh (Eng): I'll drop the runbook + terraform snippets and two price scenarios within 3 hours.
Omar (Security): will post SOC2/KMS language and webhook mTLS/IP whitelist guidance in the questionnaire.
Eileen (SE): next steps: Jordan to confirm exact pilot hours/day & legal contact; Ill schedule a 30m tech kickoff for Tue 11am PT. Assignments: Jordan confirm, Linh produce quote+runbook, Omar draft security text.
Jordan (AE): will confirm pilot hours and legal contact by 3pm PT.
Eileen (SE): thanks all :thumbsup: tagging @Linh @Omar @SDKBot for deliverables.
